purpose: Learn linear dependencies between the values of an existing signed code bank
source_functions: All available training functions, 400 or 800; no validation functions in source fitting
indexers: Reuse the existing G34 and Pair bank candidates, without rebuilding or reading teachers
fixed_index_ablation: Use the previous fresh-selected G34/Pair index; select only the linear-map dimension and ridge
joint_selection: Select existing index, map dimension and ridge on the existing validation tasks
source_weight_fit: Per-output minimum-norm least squares on the input coordinates retained by the index, followed by signed averaging within each code
linear_map: Uncentered SVD of code vectors in the weight-space metric; retain singular values divided by sqrt(number of source functions), thereby factoring the empirical code covariance
selection_tolerance: Prefer the smallest dimension, then the fewest codes, then the smallest ridge among candidates within 1e-12 + 0.001 * best validation MSE of the best
controls: LC-SVD with a supplied width-3 local architecture, explicitly an architecture oracle
Validation-tuned MSR and dimension-tuned MTSR representations
FC, LC, Conv and Joint representations
target_solver: Same fresh support-only minimum-norm/ridge regression for every representation; numerical source initialization and meta-learned rates discarded
native_references: Additionally reevaluate frozen validation-tuned native MSR and MTSR, averaging their three existing training seeds; report separately from the common-solver comparison
test_creation: Only after every validation choice is frozen; generator access exclusively in test generation
uncertainty: Paired task confidence intervals conditional on this source environment; not independent repetitions of bank recovery
timing: Report incremental source refit/SVD/validation time separately; prior bank construction and baseline meta-training are reused
